此文档保留旧颜色映射。升级后可独立编辑内部和外部，颜色外观可能改变。: This document retains its previous color mapping. Upgrade to edit interior and exterior colors independently; the appearance may change.

网格按端点探测或显式 U 接缝设置闭环；点模式按 U 周期设置。强制闭环只改变颜: Meshes use endpoint probes or explicit U seam settings; points use U periodicity. Forcing closure changes color only, not geometry.
颜色绑定变换前 Z 采样域。缩放、平移和旋转不会重新归一化颜色；旧文档保留原有空: Color follows the Z sampling domain before transforms. Scaling, translation and rotation do not renormalize colors; older documents retain the legacy spatial metric.

拖尾颜色必须在 0–1: Trail colors must be between 0 and 1

常用线宽为 0.1–32 像素，不随空间缩放改变。设为 0 隐藏线段，粒子头部仍: A typical width is 0.1–32 canvas pixels; spatial scaling does not change it. Set 0 to hide segments while keeping particle heads.

参数范围须有限、下限小于上限，步长为可表示的正数且不超过范围宽度: Range endpoints must be finite with the lower bound below the upper bound. The step must be a representable positive number no larger than the range width.
参数范围 JSON 必须是最多 32768 字符的文本: Parameter range JSON must be text of at most 32768 characters
参数范围 JSON 需要 version:1 和 ranges 对象: Parameter range JSON requires version:1 and a ranges object
参数范围最多保存 128 项: At most 128 parameter ranges can be stored
参数采样分数须为 0 至 1 的有限数值: The parameter sampling fraction must be finite and between 0 and 1
参数采样结果不是有限数值: The sampled parameter is not finite
参数滑块仅支持 Symmetry 和 Samila: Parameter sliders support Symmetry and Samila only

等待当前画布完成后，从该帧的场景时间开始播放。录制按实际秒数停止；计算较慢时会重: Playback starts at the completed frame’s scene time. Recording stops by wall-clock time and may repeat images during slow calculations. Use Export artwork for a fixed frame count or higher resolution.

Samila 相机保持旧本地模型；未应用 camera.theta，原值保留在: The Samila camera retains the legacy local model. camera.theta is not applied; its original value remains in source.

选择收敛残差模式会启用独立内外着色，旧颜色外观可能改变。: Choosing residual convergence enables separate interior and exterior coloring. The previous appearance may change.
Magnet/Binocular 收敛残差模式使用 CPU，分别保留停止距离与着: Magnet/Binocular residual convergence uses the CPU and retains separate stopping distances and color residuals. The GPU numerical path for this mode has not been verified.
收敛残差模式需要独立内外着色；请启用独立着色或选择兼容旧文档。: Residual convergence requires separate interior and exterior coloring. Enable independent coloring or select legacy compatibility.
收敛点使用外部着色，保留停止距离与着色残差。Magnet I 按源着色器使用零残: Converged points use outside coloring and retain the stopping distance and color residual. Magnet I uses zero color residual as in the source shader; Magnet II and Binocular use their respective distances. A zero Magnet threshold disables convergence. GPU computation uses its supported numeric range, with uncertain pixels repaired on the CPU.
WebGL2 双 float 有理轨道与收敛残差；临界比较或数值不确定像素使用: WebGL2 double-float rational orbits and convergence residuals; boundary comparisons and numerically uncertain pixels are repaired with CPU double precision.
请等待 Samila 相机画面完成后再调整视图: Wait for the Samila camera image to finish before adjusting the view

残差 GPU 参数或坐标超出双 float 表示范围: Residual GPU parameters or coordinates exceed the double-float range
残差 GPU 只接受 Magnet/Binocular residual 配置。: Residual GPU only accepts Magnet or Binocular residual configurations.
Binocular 非整数指数仍使用 CPU 复幂；残差 GPU 当前只验证整数: Non-integer Binocular powers use CPU complex exponentiation; residual GPU currently validates integer rational functions only.
残差 GPU 单批最多 65536 个有限像素，画布尺寸必须为正整数: Residual GPU accepts up to 65,536 finite pixels per batch; canvas dimensions must be positive integers

残差 GPU 返回无效轨道记录: Residual GPU returned an invalid orbit record
参数按声明的 float uniform 传入；缺失值为 0。源码与说明文字会随: Parameters are passed to matching float uniforms; missing values are zero. Source and description are saved with the project.
匹配列表不代表每个参数都影响结果；未被公式使用的参数仍会保留。: A match does not guarantee that a parameter affects the result. Parameters unused by the formula are retained.
自定义公式需要 GPU。切换模板会停用当前源码，保留已有参数；可撤销恢复。: Custom formulas require a GPU. Switching templates deactivates this source and retains parameter values; Undo restores it.

GLSL 参数名称（字母或下划线开头）: GLSL parameter name (starts with a letter or underscore)
自定义 Symmetry GLSL 仅支持 GPU 持续密度；不能使用 CPU: Custom Symmetry GLSL requires continuous GPU density; it cannot be replaced by a built-in CPU equation.
自定义 Symmetry GLSL 无法在 GPU 上执行；未使用内建方程替代：: Custom Symmetry GLSL could not run on the GPU; no built-in equation was substituted: {reason}
自定义 Symmetry GLSL 仅支持持续批次密度；单次采样不可用。: Custom Symmetry GLSL supports continuous density batches; single sampling is unavailable.
自定义 Symmetry GLSL 不支持内建模板探索；请先显式选择标准或径向修: Custom Symmetry GLSL cannot use built-in template exploration; explicitly select Standard or Modified first.
内置模板支持 2 至 50 的整数阶数；请先调整编译阶数，当前自定义源码保持不变: Built-in templates support integer degrees from 2 to 50. Adjust the compile-time degree first; the custom source remains unchanged.
匹配源码中的 float uniform；是否影响结果取决于公式。: Matches a float uniform in the source; its effect depends on the formula.

保留参数；源码尚无法准备，绑定状态未知。: Retained parameter; source preparation failed, so binding is unknown.

参数 {name} 仍被启用的动画引用；请先停用或修改该动画，参数与动画保持不变: Parameter {name} is referenced by an enabled animation. Disable or edit that animation first; the parameter and animation remain unchanged.
自定义对称缺少纹理状态: Custom symmetry texture state is missing
自定义对称 uniform {name} 不是标量 float: Custom symmetry uniform {name} is not a scalar float

源距离估计规则会启用独立内外着色；原算法、参数和色板保留。切换可能改变颜色，兼容: Source distance rules enable independent inside and outside coloring while preserving algorithms, parameters and palettes. Switching may change colors; compatibility mode retains the previous calculation behavior.
当前公式不满足源距离估计条件，实际使用 Smooth；保留 Distance E: This formula does not meet the source distance-estimation conditions, so Smooth is used. The Distance Estimator selection and parameters are retained.
当前公式类型不支持距离估计。: The current formula type does not support distance estimation.
复数指数不支持源距离估计。: Complex powers do not support source distance estimation.
非整数指数不支持源距离估计。: Noninteger powers do not support source distance estimation.
当前递推公式不支持源距离估计。: The current recurrence does not support source distance estimation.
回退沿用距离着色幂次，不读取未启用的 Smooth 参数。: The fallback uses the distance-coloring power and does not read inactive Smooth parameters.

Distance Estimator 使用源参数默认值 2、float32 转换: Distance Estimator uses the source default of 2, float32 conversion and a minimum of 2. Unsupported formulas use Smooth under the source rules; the original algorithm and parameters remain in source.
源规则下，内部距离着色索引为 0。: Under source rules, the interior distance-color index is 0.
启用空间显示会使用源系数表、源色板和渐进采样；已有本地公式与颜色保留。: Spatial display uses source coefficients, the source palette and progressive sampling. Existing local formulas and colors are retained.
应用显示方式并重新采样: Apply display mode and restart sampling
密度图的缩放、平移、空间变换和画布尺寸变化会清除已有墨迹，后续采样继续；调色和角: Density zoom, center, transform and canvas-size changes clear existing ink while subsequent sampling continues. Tone and angle edits retain the ink.
点云拖影随绘制次数累积；保存作品保留参数，重新打开会从新采样开始。: Point-cloud trails accumulate with render calls. Saving keeps the parameters; reopening starts a new sampling session.
空间复根导出会从初始采样重放到所选时间，使用当前相机和导出尺寸；预览中的历史墨迹: Spatial Roots export replays sampling from the start to the selected time with the current camera and export size. Preview ink history and point-cloud trails are not copied.
点云逐点读取源色板并按到达顺序透明混合；亮度不使用密度点数归一化。: The point cloud samples the source palette per point and blends in arrival order. Brightness does not use density point-count normalization.
复根呈现规则仅适用于复根场景: Roots presentation rules apply only to a Roots scene
源复根运行实例标识必须是非空字符串: The Roots runtime instance ID must be a nonempty string
输出保留目标帧的 RGBA；预览和导出按完整帧 RGB 不透明显示，不声明与原版: Output retains target RGBA. Preview and export display the complete framebuffer RGB opaquely; native PNG alpha equivalence is not established.
空间相机与变换暂不使用旧平面动画轨道；旧轨道保留，空间参数可直接编辑。: Spatial camera and transforms currently use direct edits. Old planar animation tracks are retained but do not control the spatial view.
相机片段按列表顺序执行，片段起点不参与计算。预览使用固定帧率；循环和往返是本地预: Camera clips run in list order; clip start values are ignored. Preview uses a fixed frame rate. Loop and ping-pong are local preview options; seeking backward restarts sampling. Orbit rates can continue after the queue ends; extend the minimum playback span to preview them.
此片段按原文保留，但不在源相机队列中执行；可删除或停用。: This clip is retained but does not run in the source camera queue. You can delete or disable it.
空间相机参数定义起始状态；源相机队列只执行持续环绕、停止环绕和缩放，旧平面轨道保: Spatial camera values define the initial state. The source camera queue supports orbit, stop orbit, and zoom. Existing plane tracks are retained.
在时间线中编辑和重排相机片段；切换队列规则会保留已有片段。角速度单位为弧度/秒，: Edit and reorder camera clips in the timeline. Switching queue rules keeps existing clips. Angular rates use radians per second; zoom may be zero or negative.
空间相机参数定义起始状态；完整源场景队列执行相机与渐变动作，数值轨道保留但不执行: Spatial camera values define the initial state. The full source scene queue runs camera and gradient actions. Numeric tracks are retained but do not run.
升级为完整源场景队列: Upgrade to full source scene queue
在时间线中编辑和重排片段及渐变动作；相机角速度为弧度/秒，渐变速度为度/秒。缩放: Edit and reorder clips and gradient actions in the timeline. Camera rates use radians per second; gradients use degrees per second. Zoom may be zero or negative.
升级会保留已有动作；缺少渐变配置的旧动作需要明确设置后才执行。: Upgrading retains existing actions. Older actions without gradient settings require explicit configuration before they run.
保留的渐变动作尚无有效源配置，需要明确设置后才执行。: This retained gradient action has no valid source configuration. Configure it explicitly before it runs.
这些模式与相位曲线更新同一个源色板偏移，不替换色标。停止动作保留最后偏移；同片段: These modes and phase curves update one source palette offset without replacing color stops. Stop retains the final offset. Gradient actions within a clip run in list order.
场景片段按列表顺序执行；每个片段先启动相机及全部渐变动作，再按源顺序更新。预览使: Scene clips run in list order. Each clip starts the camera and all gradient actions before updating them in source order. Preview uses a fixed frame rate; looping and ping-pong are local policies. Orbit and running gradients may continue after the queue ends.
此片段按原文保留，但不在完整源场景队列中执行；可删除或停用。: This clip is retained but does not run in the full source scene queue. You can delete or disable it.
完整源场景队列通过渐变动作更新源偏移，停止后保留最后偏移；数值与本地色板轨道保留: The full source scene queue updates the source offset through gradient actions and retains the final offset after stopping. Numeric and local palette tracks are retained but do not run. Static source palette and tone settings remain editable.
从初始状态重放；首帧用于预热。存在源队列时按队列结束停止；空队列等待本地样本提交: Replay from the initial state; the first frame is warmup. A nonempty source queue stops recording when it ends. An empty queue waits for local samples to finish submission. Simulation FPS controls motion steps; encoder FPS controls playback speed.
复根录制预热状态与计划不一致: Roots recording warmup state does not match the plan
复根队列在录制预热帧内已结束，没有可编码帧；请延长队列: The Roots queue ended during recording warmup, leaving no frames to encode. Extend the queue.
复根录制帧与实际完成状态不一致: Roots recording frame does not match the actual completion state
此作品保留即时绘制规则；启用批次队列会改变中间画面，并从初始采样重新开始。: This artwork retains immediate drawing. Enabling the batch queue changes intermediate frames and restarts sampling from the beginning.
启用批次队列并重新采样: Enable batch queue and restart sampling
积压较多时会自适应增加绘制点数；修改基础值会重建本地实例并重新采样。: A larger backlog automatically increases the number of points drawn. Changing the base value rebuilds the local instance and restarts sampling.
点云按已完成批次接收根点；每帧基础绘制点数仅影响密度图，保留值不应用于点云。: Point clouds receive completed root batches. The base points per frame only affects density mode; its retained value does not apply to point clouds.
画布按项目比例居中适配窗口；预览质量仍决定采样像素。应用尺寸会从初始状态重新生成: The canvas fits the window using the project aspect ratio. Preview quality still determines sampling pixels. Applying dimensions regenerates from the initial state.
画布可用尺寸必须为有限正数: Available canvas dimensions must be finite positive numbers.
画布可用尺寸超出浮点范围: Available canvas dimensions exceed the floating-point range.
项目分辨率应为对象: Project resolution must be an object.
项目宽度应为 64 至 8192 的整数: Project width must be an integer from 64 to 8192.
项目高度应为 64 至 8192 的整数: Project height must be an integer from 64 to 8192.
切换只改变数值规则；指数、种子、变体、收敛模式和后端选择保留。源规则的视口范围与: Switching changes only the numeric rules. Powers, seeds, variant, convergence mode and backend selection are preserved. Source rules use a different viewport range and vertical direction, so the image may change.
源规则使用 WebGL2 双 float 运算、源参考轨道和迭代步长退出；不能以: Source rules use WebGL2 double-float arithmetic, source reference orbits and step-based termination; CPU cannot substitute for this path. Newton always uses the parameter plane, retaining an inactive Julia selection. Nova uses the selected variant.
原始阈值保留，计算时按源规则派生下限；Nova 还使用逻辑画布尺寸与缩放。此实现: The authored tolerance is preserved; source rules derive its lower bound during calculation. Nova also uses logical canvas size and zoom. Original-application framebuffer and DPI pixel equivalence have not been verified.
当前选择 CPU；源 Newton/Nova 需要 WebGL2。请选择自动或: CPU is selected; source Newton/Nova requires WebGL2. Choose Auto or WebGL2, or return to local numeric rules.
当前公式不是 Newton 或 Nova；源数值规则暂不参与计算，所选规则仍随文: This formula is neither Newton nor Nova. The source numeric rules are inactive but remain saved in the document.
源规则只支持 low、medium、high；其他已保存精度保留，计算时明确报错: Source rules support low, medium and high. Other saved precision values are preserved and produce an explicit calculation error.
草稿不会改变当前画面。验证首帧成功后应用；需要 GPU 持续批次模式。: Drafts leave the current image unchanged. Apply after the first frame passes validation; GPU continuous batches are required.
尚未生成自定义 GLSL 的 GPU 首帧，请检查持续批次与 Replay 起点: The first custom GLSL GPU frame was not generated. Check continuous batches and the Replay start setting.
通过初始参数和时间线调整视角；修改后重新计算动画。: Adjust the initial camera and timeline to change the view. Edits replay the animation.
当前使用原版相机，请在右侧相机面板或时间线调整视角。: Source camera active. Adjust the view in the camera panel or timeline.
保存的动作开关不控制源相机；请用片段开关控制执行，或删除动作。: The saved action toggle does not control the source camera. Use the clip toggle or delete the action.
此片段未接入源相机顺序队列；作者数据保留，可停用或删除。: This clip is unsupported by the source camera sequence. Its data is retained; disable or delete it.
原版相机按本地固定帧率回放；原版实时线程时钟和非相机效果仍待完整对照。: The source camera replays at a fixed local frame rate. Native live timing and non-camera effects still need full comparison.
渐变同时作用于曲面两侧；运行时循环采样色板并按记录年龄着色拖尾。停止保留最后的色: The gradient affects both sides of the surface. While running, it samples colors cyclically and colors trails by record age. Stop retains the final palette offset. Actions within a clip run in list order.
保留的参数动作尚无有效源配置。: The retained parameter action has no valid source configuration.
保留的参数片段尚无有效源配置。: The retained parameter clip has no valid source configuration.
名称按原文匹配。全部开始沿用已有参数动画；具名开始替换该参数的设置。具名停止只暂: Names match exactly. Start all resumes existing parameter animations; named start replaces that parameter’s settings. Named stop pauses only that parameter; stop all pauses every parameter.
独立参数片段会替换当前参数动画列表，按帧更新，结束时停止；片段缓动不改变参数速度: A standalone parameter clip replaces the current parameter animations, updates each frame, and stops at its end. Clip easing does not change parameter speed.
采样数包含边界端点；任一方向为 1 时没有网格面。超出本机容量会显示错误，原值不: Samples include both endpoints; a count of 1 on either axis produces no mesh faces. Values exceeding local capacity report an error without being truncated.
允许反向范围；起点与终点按输入顺序保存。: Reversed ranges are allowed; endpoints retain their entered order.
颜色格式为 #AARRGGBB，AA 表示透明度；修改 RGB 保留 AA。完整: Use #AARRGGBB, where AA is alpha. RGB edits preserve AA. Complete color values apply when the field loses focus.
正分段数启用该方向的独立曲线；两个方向都不为正时沿网格三角形绘制线框。: Positive divisions enable independent curves on that axis. If neither axis is positive, wireframe follows the mesh triangles.
跟踪点沿参数域移动，网格采样位置保持不变；时间线中的跟踪动作可让相机跟随它。: The tracking point moves through the parameter domain while the mesh sampling grid stays fixed. A timeline tracking action makes the camera follow it.
网格颜色沿 U 方向排列；闭合接缝会平滑颜色。填充透明度由网格外观控制。: Mesh colors run along U; closed seams smooth the colors. Mesh appearance controls fill opacity.
网格不生成拖尾；此片段保留原版队列时序，切换录制不会改变画面。: The mesh produces no trails. This clip preserves the original queue timing; toggling recording does not change the image.
时间线可切换点云与网格；两种模式分别使用下方的采样和外观设置。: The timeline can switch between points and mesh. Each mode uses its own sampling and appearance settings below.
先淡出到黑色，再切换曲面并淡入；参数和跟踪动作仍绑定初始曲面。: Fade to black, switch surface mode, then fade in. Parameter and tracking actions remain bound to the initial surface.
CPU 最多绘制 10000 个粒子；复杂公式、预热和拖尾还受计算预算限制。每帧: CPU draws up to 10,000 particles. Equations, warmup and trails also share a work budget. Steps per frame and timeline frame rate both affect motion.
范围端点按输入顺序保存。预热只改变初始位置，不生成拖尾。: Range endpoints retain their entered order. Warmup changes initial positions without recording trails.
拖尾记录每次积分的位置。渐变动画在显示拖尾时更新点与拖尾颜色；关闭拖尾会暂停颜色: Trails record every integration step. Gradient animation updates point and trail colors while trails are shown; hiding trails pauses color updates.
颜色格式为 #AARRGGBB，AA 表示透明度；修改 RGB 保留 AA。: Use #AARRGGBB, where AA is alpha. Editing RGB preserves AA.
颜色按粒子序号排列，支持 #AARRGGBB。未指定或空色板使用原版默认六色。: Colors follow particle indices and support #AARRGGBB. An omitted or empty palette uses the six source default colors.
色板未指定：使用默认六色: No palette specified: using six default colors
色板为空：使用默认六色: Empty palette: using six default colors
显示拖尾时更新点与拖尾颜色；停止保留最后偏移。同片段渐变动作按列表顺序执行。: Point and trail colors update while trails are shown. Stopping keeps the last offset. Gradient actions in a clip run in list order.
可添加相机与渐变动作；原版普通吸引子没有参数动画。渐变在显示拖尾时生效。: Camera and gradient actions are available. The original ordinary Attractor has no parameter animation. Gradients take effect while trails are shown.
原版普通吸引子没有参数动画。修改参数会从初始状态重新计算。: The original ordinary Attractor has no parameter animation. Parameter edits replay from the initial state.
GPU 按当前帧叠加粒子密度，不绘制拖尾，也不执行渐变动画。CPU 的拖尾设置仍: GPU accumulates particle density for the current frame without trails or gradient animation. CPU trail settings are preserved.
色调数值按原版范围限制。密度比例控制当前帧的叠加亮度，不延长轨迹。: Tone values use the original limits. Density scale controls the current frame’s accumulated brightness, not trail duration.
源 Samila 实数语法：函数名紧邻左括号；x、y 为采样坐标，a–d 缺省为: Source Samila real expressions: function names must directly precede the opening parenthesis. x and y are sample coordinates; a–d default to 0. Other variables must be declared as parameters. Time is not injected.
片段结束时停止全部 Samila 参数漂移；过渡期间已有漂移继续。: Stops all Samila parameter drift at the end of the clip. Existing drift continues during the transition.
源 Samila 队列按固定帧率回放；仅 theta 参与密度显示，其他相机分量: The source Samila queue uses fixed-rate replay. Only theta affects the density display; other camera components retain their runtime state.
初相位来自作品初始参数；片段完成后替换持续漂移列表。步长按每个参考帧计算，负值反: Initial phase comes from the artwork’s initial parameters. Completing the clip replaces the persistent drift list. Step is per reference frame; negative values reverse direction.
Samila 片段按列表顺序执行，未知原片段作为等待。参数在队列结束后停止更新，: Samila clips run in list order; unknown source clips become waits. Parameters stop updating when the queue ends; ambient camera motion continues per frame. Preview and export share the document frame rate.
色标等距排列，使用 RGB 插值。: Color stops are evenly spaced and use RGB interpolation.
源 spot_size，经主画布物理高度换算；不等同像素半径。: Source spot_size, scaled by the primary canvas pixel height; this is not a pixel radius.
Samila 导出缺少主画布物理高度，请等待预览完成: Samila export needs the primary canvas pixel height. Wait for the preview to finish.
使用运行时随机样本；参数改变时，采样量增至六倍。: Uses runtime random samples. Parameter changes increase the sample count to six times the base batch.
Samila 预览按实际经过时间连续运行，暂停期间不推进。片段按顺序执行；队列结: Samila previews run continuously using elapsed time and stop advancing while paused. Clips execute in order; after the queue ends, parameters stop updating while the camera and drawing continue. Seeking rebuilds the image; video export recalculates frames at the selected frame rate.
Symmetry 按实际经过时间运行。暂停后的调色板和变换编辑会重播画面；队列结: Symmetry runs in real time. Palette and transform edits replay the image while paused. Particles and active parameter animations continue after the queue ends. Seeking rebuilds the scene frame by frame; video export recomputes it at the selected frame rate.
队列在预热帧内已结束，没有可编码帧；请延长队列: The queue ended during warmup with no frames to encode; extend the queue.
录制实际尺寸与预检不一致，请等待预览完成后重试: Recording dimensions differ from the preflight; wait for the preview and retry.
从上次应用的配置开始，首帧预热后按队列结束停止；编码完成后动画继续播放。帧率同时: Start from the last applied configuration, discard one warmup frame, then stop when the queue completes. The animation resumes after encoding finishes. One frame rate controls both simulation and video encoding.
暂停时拖动平移、滚轮缩放；恢复播放保留平移和缩放。: While paused, drag to pan and scroll to zoom. Pan and zoom are retained on resume.
暂停时拖动旋转、滚轮缩放；恢复播放还原旋转角度、保留缩放。: While paused, drag to rotate and scroll to zoom. Resume restores rotation and retains zoom.
应用后从头重建场景，并保留当前播放或暂停状态。: Applying rebuilds the scene from the beginning and keeps it playing or paused.
有未应用的修改；当前动画继续使用运行配置。: Unapplied changes; the animation continues using the running configuration.
自定义 GLSL 需要 GPU 首帧验证: Custom GLSL requires GPU first-frame validation
从片段开始时的视口出发，按缩放倍率移动中心；起点会跟随之前的动画和视口修改。: Starts from the viewport at the beginning of this clip. Center motion follows the zoom ratio; previous animations and viewport edits update the start.
分形队列在预热帧内已结束，没有可编码帧；请延长队列: The Fractal queue ended during warmup with no frames to encode; extend the queue.
从当前配置重新开始，先绘制一帧预热，再录到队列结束。使用三倍导出画布，MP4 使: Start fresh from the current configuration, discard one warmup frame, then record until the queue ends. Render at triple size; MP4 uses the source quality settings. Simulation and encoder FPS default to the same value; independent speed adjustment is a local extension.
有待应用的修改；修改几何参数也会应用当前分形设置。: Changes are waiting to be applied. Editing geometry also applies the current fractal settings.
时间线或场景外观有修改，需在播放时应用才能替换当前运行场景。: Timeline or scene appearance changes require Apply while playing to replace the running scene.
暂停时应用保留当前动画进度；播放时应用会从头运行新的时间线。: Apply while paused keeps the current animation progress. Apply while playing restarts with the new timeline.
按当前暂停状态生成图像，再按所选倍率放大。输出 {width} × {heigh: Render the current paused state, then upscale by the selected factor. Output {width} × {height} pixels.
保存当前暂停的分形状态，不推进动画；尺寸只改变导出画面。: Save the current paused fractal state without advancing animation; size only changes the exported image.
从当前配置按固定时间重放，不复制实时预览的编辑历史。: Replay the current configuration at a fixed time without copying the live preview edit history.
暂停保留当前画面；跳转会从初始配置重建。修改时间线后，请在播放时点击“应用场景”: Pause keeps the current frame; seeking rebuilds from the initial configuration. After editing the timeline, click Apply scene during playback.
按固定帧率回放；跳转会从初始配置重建。: Playback uses a fixed frame rate; seeking rebuilds from the initial configuration.
尚未确认录制保存结果，重试会继续同一个任务。: The recording save result is not confirmed. Retry continues the same task.
从上次完整应用的场景录制: Record the last fully applied scene
从上次完整应用的场景开始，预热后录到队列结束，编码完成后继续播放。帧率同时用于模: Start from the last fully applied scene, warm up, then record until the queue ends. Playback continues after encoding. The frame rate controls both simulation and encoding. To record your edits, play the scene and click Apply scene first.
域着色片段按列表顺序执行；预览与导出使用固定帧率，时间跳转会重建对应画面。队列结: Domain coloring clips run in list order. Preview and export use a fixed frame rate; seeking rebuilds the selected frame. Active rotation, parameters, and gradients can continue after the queue ends.
位置相对画布中心，单位为主预览逻辑像素；正值向右、向下。缩放保留原版数值，导出按: Position is relative to the canvas centre in primary preview logical pixels; positive values move right and down. Scale keeps the original value; export uses the primary preview height.
暂停动画后仍继续计算并画完剩余点；重新开始会清除当前画面。: Pausing animation keeps computing and drawing remaining points. Restart clears the current image.
此作品保留按时间顺序回放；启用后台实时采样会重新开始。: This artwork uses sequential replay. Enabling background sampling starts a new run.
复根后台采样与动画时钟独立；暂停后继续画完剩余点。返回起点会重新采样。离线视频按: Root sampling runs independently of animation. Pausing finishes the remaining points; returning to the start begins a new run. Offline video uses sequential replay at the selected frame rate.
后台实时采样请使用返回起点重新开始: Use Return to start to restart background sampling.
从当前配置重新计算，预热后录制；有动画时录到队列结束，无动画时等待全部点绘制完成: Recompute the current configuration and record after warmup. Stop when the animation queue finishes, or after all points have been drawn when there is no animation. You can stop and save at any time; playback resumes after saving.
